text:
morgan: FYI saw a short but loud reconnect burst in us-east after we flipped the keepalive/idle-timeout to be more aggressive on the edge proxies. reconnects ~4x for ~9m, a handful of customers reported being charged twice. anyone grabbed traces?
lee: got traces. pattern: client hits keepalive timeout, closes, then websocket reconnects but resume token rejected because token-issuer rotated concurrently. result = new session.
anika: log snippet:```text
2026-07-11T02:10:03Z WARN resume reject token=rt:us:xyz cause=issuer_epoch_mismatch
2026-07-11T02:10:04Z INFO new session created sid=ws-12a client=10.0.8.9 billing_flag=new_open
```
ved: so two independent changes combined: idle-timeout down + token-issuer rotation + routing-gen bump. small race window but high impact.
morgan: can we do a quick mitigation that doesn't require rollback? maybe accept previous issuer for a short grace window and add metric that counts such accepts.
lee: that's low-risk if we scope it regionally and set a 60s grace. but it weakens anti-replay guarantees briefly. we should also auto-pause rollout if grace_accept rate > threshold.
anika: console request: show a "resume-collision risk" badge when users change both idle-timeout and token-issuer in same rollout. product wants to warn before confirm.
ved: ops wants more: emit rollout.event.resume_collision_risk with detail keys and surface in canary view. add canary gate: if stream.reconnect.burst_ratio > 2x or stream.resume.legacy_accept_rate > 0.3% -> auto-pause.
morgan: billing note: because billing currently flags "new session" on open, we need to adjust billing pipeline to mark session_as_resume when token candidates nearby. that will let us dedupe downstream. filing BILL-500. @finops-bot can you start provisional credits?
finops-bot: BILL-500 created. provisional credits queued for review.
lee: long-term: change resume token design. options: (1) include issuer epoch but allow verifier to accept +/-1 epoch; (2) separate long-lived resume handle + short-lived proof-of-possession. leaning to (2) so we avoid accepting older signatures.
anika: also add telemetry: stream.resume.legacy_accepted_count, stream.resume.reject_epoch_mismatch, trace tag resume_gating=accepted|rejected and surface in trace-flame for postmortem.
ved: small infra change: when performing rollouts that touch token-issuer, add preflight sim that exercises: token-rotation + keepalive delta + route-gen switch. pipeline should flag if simulated accept rate < 99.9%. ticket INFRA-777.
morgan: quick ops mitigation for now: increase keepalive back to previous value for affected regions and pause issuer rotation for 120s. will push a config flag now.
deploy-bot: config change applied: proxy-keepalive us-east -> 45s -> 2026-07-11T02:12:30Z
ops-bot: alert muted: reconnect-burst resolved 2026-07-11T02:13:10Z
lee: followups: CONSOLE-911 (risk badge + canary view), INFRA-777 (preflight sim), SRE-9001 (auto-pause gating), BILL-500 (billing reconciliation). I'll start the RFC for resume token revamp.
morgan: thanks all. I'll capture timeline and draft incident note. paste short facts here and i'll assemble. :memo:
